source: U.S. Energy Information Administration Open Data API

region_choice.rationale: Virginia is a data-center-heavy state; the COMMERCIAL-sector retail price is the analytically honest signal for whether AI/data-center demand is raising prices (data centers are commercial/industrial customers), versus residential rates that move for different, more insulated reasons.

series_description: Electricity sales to ultimate customer by state and sector -- COMMERCIAL sector, Virginia (average price, cents/kWh). Sources: Forms EIA-826, EIA-861, EIA-861M.
sector_divergence_note: Commercial ~flat (+1-2%) Dec 2025-Jul 2026 while residential is ~+14.5% YoY. Virginia recently created a dedicated data-center-specific rate class (SCC/Dominion filings), which appears to insulate the general commercial class from data-center cost pass-through; residential absorbs base-rate hikes and PJM capacity-auction increases.
baseline_status: most recent actual EIA commercial-sector observation
